elig.title: Free · 60 seconds
elig.disclaimer: This is an indicative guide, not a decision — only the embassy decides.
elig.strongT: Your profile looks strong on paper. The next step is making the file match it: consistent documents, a clear travel plan and a well-written cover letter.
elig.moderateT: You have a fair chance, with a few weak points. In a free call we will tell you exactly what to strengthen before you pay any embassy fee.
elig.needsT: Applying right now carries a high refusal risk. Let us plan the steps first — for example building travel history or documenting funds — so your application starts strong.

choose.title: Choose your visa page
choose.immNote: Immigration rules change often — each pathway page shows the official source and the date we last checked it. Where the law requires a licensed representative (for example an RCIC for Canada or a registered migration agent for Australia), cases are filed with our licensed partners.

reviews.title: Client reviews
reviews.note: Every review here is from a real client. Clients post their own review; we approve it before it appears to stop spam — we never edit the words or hide fair criticism.
